claims: The main campus of the University of Connecticut (UConn) is located in Storrs, CT.
Storrs, CT is in the northeastern part of Connecticut.
UConn's main campus is situated approximately 22 miles east of Hartford.
UConn's main campus is situated about halfway between New York City and Boston.
UConn's Storrs campus is the primary residential campus.
UConn's Storrs campus is a rural setting.
UConn's Storrs campus acts as its own town.
UConn has four additional regional campuses located across Connecticut.
UConn's Avery Point regional campus is located in Groton.
UConn's Hartford regional campus is located in Hartford.
UConn's Stamford regional campus is located in Stamford.
UConn's Waterbury regional campus is located in Waterbury.
UConn operates UConn Health in Farmington.
UConn operates the UConn School of Law in Hartford.
